dialogues.speaker: Aeife
dialogues.text: Take a guess — will Monsieur Neuvillette preside over the next trial? Will Lady Furina make an appearance?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Neuvillette...

dialogues.speaker: Aeife
dialogues.text: Right! So, he's our Chief Justice, and the one who brought us Melusines to the Court of Fontaine to live.

dialogues.speaker: Aeife
dialogues.text: He's always very busy with work, and can only preside over some cases, and his subordinates in the Maison Ordalie handle the rest.

dialogues.speaker: Aeife
dialogues.text: But no matter how busy he is, he will still greet us when he sees us — just as he's done for several hundred years now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me about Furina?

dialogues.speaker: Aeife
dialogues.text: Lady Furina's very lovely, like the soft seafoam reflecting the sunlight.

dialogues.speaker: Aeife
dialogues.text: But her temper is... Well, she's hard to read. Sometimes, she's like tempestuous waves, and other times, like stagnant water in a deep pool.

dialogues.speaker: Aeife
dialogues.text: I guess gods have more intense emotions than humans, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll be waiting in suspense.

dialogues.speaker: Aeife
dialogues.text: Yup, that we will!

dialogues.speaker: Aeife
dialogues.text: Take a guess — will Monsieur Neuvillette preside over the next trial? Will Lady Furina make an appearance in the opera house?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me about Furina?

dialogues.speaker: Aeife
dialogues.text: Lady Furina's very lovely, like the soft seafoam reflecting the sunlight.

dialogues.speaker: Aeife
dialogues.text: But her temper was... Well, she was hard to read. Sometimes, she was like tempestuous waves, and other times, like stagnant water in a deep pool.

dialogues.speaker: Aeife
dialogues.text: It's been a while since I've seen her though... You know, I've just decided that the next time I see her, I'm going to give her a friendly greeting and my biggest smile!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Furina...

dialogues.speaker: Aeife
dialogues.text: Lady Furina's very lovely, like the soft seafoam reflecting the sunlight.

dialogues.speaker: Aeife
dialogues.text: But her temper was... Well, she was hard to read. Sometimes, she was like tempestuous waves, and other times, like stagnant water in a deep pool.

dialogues.speaker: Aeife
dialogues.text: But I don't feel like that anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Aeife
dialogues.text: Lady Furina seemed very cheerful the last time I saw her. She said she might be able to come to the opera house more often! I do hope she does.
